  Test:
```
  
    1. Create a cluster with required g-flags and noes in 3 regions.
    2. Schema creation:
        a. Create 6 tablespace for(2 for each region)
        b. Create 3 colocated database and in each db create the following
            i. Create 2 colocated tables and 1 non-colocated table in each
                tablespaces.
            ii. Create a colocated geo-partitioned parent table and
                3 child tables(1 for each region).
            iii. Create a non-colocated geo-partitioned parent table and
                3 child tables(1 for each region).
            iv. Create indexes on all the tables.
        c. Create 1 normal database and execute the following
            i. Create 2 tables in each tablespaces
            ii.  Create a geo-partitioned parent table and
                3 child tables(1 for each region).
            iii. Create all types of indexes on all the tables
    3. Create a PITR and DB Clone on each database
    4. Start a thread which will insert,update and delete fix amount of rows
        in all the tables.
    5. Validate the data and ensure all rows are in the correct region.
    6. Note down the time and data-(T0)
    7. Create a backup of one colocated DB and one non-colocated DB.
    8. Move all the data of one tablespace to another created tabelspace
        using Alter
        a. Move only colocated tables
        b. Move both
    9.Validate the data/tables are moved to the new tablespace.
    10. Restore to time T0 and validate the data.
    11. Drop the DBs for which the backup was created.
    12. Restore the backups and validate the data and objects.
    13. Insert new data in the restore dbs and validate data.
```
